subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Should session recency be derived at read time from recent transcript/run/session events, persisted as a canonical `lastMeaningfulActivityAt` field, or deferred in favor of the current `updatedAt` behavior?
rationale: The issue changes core session semantics and UI behavior, and the discussion identifies a real storage/write-load tradeoff that automation should not decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Derive on read from recent events
options.body: Compute a bounded meaningful-activity projection for `sessions.list` and Control UI rows, avoiding parent-row rewrites on every child/background event while still exposing the sort reason.

options.title: Persist canonical activity fields
options.body: Add stored activity timestamps and migration/tests if maintainers explicitly accept the write path and define which events update parent and child rows.

options.title: Defer the activity model
options.body: Keep `updatedAt` sorting for now and leave the issue open until the session-event taxonomy and performance budget are ready.

recommendation.title: Derive on read from recent events
recommendation.body: Compute a bounded meaningful-activity projection for `sessions.list` and Control UI rows, avoiding parent-row rewrites on every child/background event while still exposing the sort reason.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and repository product-routing context make steipete the best available owner to choose the product/storage direction, with BunsDev and Takhoffman as likely implementation reviewers.
